journeys.measurement: Measure visible selection and saved-draft return feedback after keyboard activation in normal and reduced-motion contexts.

composition.observation: The creation page places four large intention cards in a balanced desktop grid and a vertical mobile sequence; the editor retains distinct work regions.

hierarchy.observation: A prominent creation heading and gold manual cue lead directly to the draft title and Chronicle Details controls in the real editor.

typography.observation: Serif headings and sans-serif instructions remain legible at both captured widths; the small editor toolbar labels are still discernible.

spacing.observation: The choice cards have generous padding, and the narrow editor wraps its action buttons into separated rows without visible collision.

controls.observation: The manual card, title rename, Details, Save details, and Studio return are named and visually actionable; unavailable choices are marked Coming soon.

contrast.observation: Cream headings, muted explanatory copy, and gold active actions remain readable on the dark teal cards and editor surfaces.

consistency.observation: The shared Studio shell, account control, dark palette, and draft terminology persist from choice entry through editor and Library return.

states.observation: Fresh media shows choice entry, untitled draft editor, renamed and saved Details, then a named private draft card in the Creator Library.

responsive.observation: The mobile choice cards stack, editor controls wrap, and Save details plus Saved at stay within the mobile normal and reduced viewports.

keyboard.observation: All four protected Chronicle traces activate the route with Tab and Enter; the same traces show a long forward-only focus sequence after save.

focus.observation: Outlines make the current title and controls visible; trace navigation reaches Close Details and Studio, while this protected run does not exercise Escape.

feedback.observation: Saved at is visibly placed beneath or beside Save details in all four desktop/mobile and normal/reduced saved screenshots; transition measurements are under 153 ms.

motion.observation: Normal and reduced WebM samples and trace frames reach stable editor, saved, and returned states without an observed disruptive transition.

continuity.observation: Manual selection opens an owned untitled editor; the same named private Chronicle and saved description appear on return to Library.

complexity.observation: The manual path asks for no preliminary metadata, although the full editor presents many controls after entry; primary actions remain separated.

role-outcomes.observation: The Creator can start manually, edit title and details, save, and see a private unpublished draft with the new description in Library.

fallbacks.observation: AI, Adapt a Story, and Start from a Template are fully shown as Coming soon in the desktop recording while manual creation remains operational.

findings.observation: After Save details, the captured forward-only keyboard route traverses over 100 Tab stops to Close Details and about 100 more toward Studio. This capture does not exercise the coded Escape shortcut.

limits: The protected journey returns to the Library but does not freshly reload, reopen, or re-edit the saved draft.

The six protected traces use Tab and Enter; Escape and reverse-Tab behavior are not demonstrated by this capture. Matching candidate source was inspected only after media and contains an Escape close handler and trigger focus restoration; source is supporting evidence, not an observed interaction.
Zero reported serious axe findings and visible skip links do not establish screen-reader speech.
Visual ownership labels do not alone prove canonical identity or privacy isolation.
This is a fresh media pass in the same reviewer task path, which had prior task history; prior judgments were not reused. No physical device or owner acceptance is claimed.

composition.observation: All Workspaces presents three balanced desktop capability cards that become a readable single-column mobile route.

hierarchy.observation: The shared account message leads to Player, Captain, and Creator entry actions; each destination foregrounds its own primary task.

typography.observation: Large destination headings, card names, and empty-state explanations remain legible at desktop and mobile capture sizes.

spacing.observation: Capability cards have ample room and mobile controls wrap; focused destination heading outlines sit close to the next descriptive line.

controls.observation: Enter actions, account disclosure, Captain tabs, and Chronicle choice cards have discernible labels and active or unavailable states.

contrast.observation: Gold primary actions, light labels, and muted supporting copy remain readable against dark workspace and destination backgrounds.

consistency.observation: The same Voyagewright frame and synthetic account indicator persist through Creator, Captain, Player, and return to All Workspaces.

states.observation: The captured journey includes available workspace entry, empty Creator and Captain states, creation choices, Player empty state, and final return.

responsive.observation: Workspace cards stack on mobile and Captain tabs wrap without a visible horizontal scroll or clipped primary action.

keyboard.observation: The desktop and mobile reduced-motion traces record Tab and Enter activation through Creator, account menu, Captain, Player, and return.

focus.observation: A visible focus outline and Skip to main content link appear during keyboard traversal; a few large heading outlines closely touch body copy.

feedback.observation: Available badges, no-content guidance, and Player server-confirmed state explain each observed capability and empty-state outcome.

motion.observation: Both reduced-motion recordings and traces move among the shared destinations without an observed animation-dependent step.

continuity.observation: The synthetic account remains visible at entry and each role destination, then returns to the same All Workspaces screen.

complexity.observation: Three role cards and task-specific empty states keep entry understandable; the account menu offers a direct All Workspaces return.

role-outcomes.observation: The same account reaches Creator Library, previews the creation intentions, then reaches Captain and Player before returning.

fallbacks.observation: Empty workspaces provide next actions, while AI, adaptation, and template intentions visibly say Coming soon in scrolled trace frames.

findings.observation: Focused Creator, Captain, and Player headings have outlines that nearly meet the following description line on mobile; the text remains readable and navigation succeeds.

limits: The visible account indicator does not itself prove canonical account IDs, capability isolation, or another owner private-resource exclusion.
This capture samples empty workspace navigation, not a live Voyage or physical-device use.
The Homeport contract is reduced-motion only in this packet; normal-motion Homeport behavior was not captured.
